items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: I played with old man Gus Metcalf, Noel Foster.

ctx.x: What was he sick of? Was there any particular sickness that he had?

Well I wouldn't know exactly but Buddy had so much exposure I mad about running the TV. That's what it looked more like because I never did hear what he died with but that's what he looked more like. He used to drink hard and plenty night exposure, play them dances and go out in the air and all like that. That's where the most of the old musicians died from exposure to help kill itself you know. He get in them hot places and come out with no coats on. A man can track a whole lot of coal like that. It'd feel good…
Was that during the last war or about when was the memory of that?
